age.evidence: Adult male ICR (CD-1) mice weighing 30-35 g

sex.evidence: Adult male ICR (CD-1) mice weighing 30-35 g

dosing.evidence: Drugs were dissolved in Tween 80 (2%) and ethanol (5%), brought to the final volume with saline (0.9% NaCl), and administered by intraperitoneal (i.p.) injection
25I-NBOMe ... dissolved in Tween 80 (2%) and ethanol (5%), brought to the final volume with saline (0.9% NaCl), administered i.p.
25B-NBOMe ... dissolved in Tween 80 (2%) and ethanol (5%), administered i.p.
LSD ... dissolved in Tween 80 (2%) and ethanol (5%), brought to the final volume with saline (0.9% NaCl), and administered by intraperitoneal (i.p.) injection

group_housing.evidence: group-housed (5 mice per cage, 80 cm2 floor area per animal)

day_night_flipped.evidence: exposed to a 12:12 h light-dark cycle (light period from 6:30 a.m. to 6:30 p.m.); experiments performed from 8:30 a.m. to 2:00 p.m.

assays.assay_description: Sensorimotor reflex test measuring the mouse's visual response to a stationary object in a 350x350x350 mm chamber; measured at 10, 30, 60, 120, 180, 240, and 300 min post-injection.

setup_restrain.evidence: each mouse was housed in an experimental chamber (350x350x350 mm)

food_restriction.evidence: standard testing apparatus with no food in chamber

water_restriction.evidence: standard testing apparatus with no water in chamber

sample_size.evidence: eight mice (total mice used: 336) were used for each treatment (vehicle or 5 doses)

outcomes.summary: All compounds (25H/I/B-NBOMe, 2C-H/I/B, LSD) dose-dependently inhibited visual object response. Halogenated NBOMes were more potent than 2C analogs and LSD.
outcomes.evidence: -NBOMe, 2C compounds, and LSD inhibit visual object response in mice in a dose-dependent manner

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: measured 10, 30, 60, 120, 180, 240, and 300 min after injection within session

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Experiments were conducted in blind by trained observers

E1_environment_type.evidence: experimental chamber (350x350x350 mm) made with black methacrylate walls

E2_shelter.evidence: open chamber with transparent front door

E3_bedding.evidence: cages cleaned with ethanol; no bedding mentioned

E7_social_context.evidence: each mouse was housed in an experimental chamber

D1_continuity.evidence: measured at 10, 30, 60, 120, 180, 240, 300 min — multiple observation timepoints

D2_session_duration.evidence: individual observations at discrete timepoints; session duration not specified as ≥15 min

D4_baseline.evidence: no pre-drug baseline reported for this measure

assays.assay_description: Sensorimotor test measuring visual response while the animal is moving (lowered toward a surface); measured at 15, 35, 65, 125, 185, 245, and 305 min post-injection.

setup_restrain.evidence: mouse held by tail and lowered toward surface during recording

outcomes.summary: NBOMes (25H most potent), 2C-I, 2C-B and LSD dose-dependently reduced visual placing response; 2C-H ineffective.
outcomes.evidence: Systemic administration of 25H-NBOMe reduced in a dose-dependent manner the visual placing response in mice

D4_baseline.evidence: baseline normalization mentioned but no pre-drug session described as separate test

assays.assay_description: Reflex test of the mouse's response to four acoustic stimuli of differing intensity/frequency, measured at 10, 30, 60, 120, 180, 240, 300 min post-injection.

outcomes.summary: All NBOMes and 2C compounds decreased acoustic responses dose-dependently; LSD did not significantly inhibit acoustic responses (slight overexcitation in first hour). 25I-NBOMe most potent.
outcomes.evidence: -NBOMe and 2C compounds but not LSD were inhibitory in this test

assays.assay_description: Sum of vibrissae, corneal, and pinnae reflexes; measured at 10, 30, 60, 120, 180, 240, 300 min post-injection.

setup_restrain.evidence: brief manual restraint required to test corneal/pinnae/vibrissae reflexes

outcomes.summary: Overall tactile response unchanged by NBOMes and 2C compounds. LSD produced a dose-dependent hyperstimulation of tactile response.
outcomes.evidence: LSD (0.001-10 mg/kg i.p.) showed a dose-dependent effect of hyperstimulation on the tactile response

B1_num_measures.evidence: Data are expressed as the sum of the three afore-mentioned parameters (vibrissae, corneal, pinnae reflexes)

assays.assay_description: Mice dropped from 3 cm in 150x150 cm open area; latency to first forelimb movement measured at 15, 40, 70, 130, 190, 250, 310 min post-injection.

setup_habituation.evidence: Mice were accustomed by placing them in the center of a square area (150 x 150 cm) for 5 min

outcomes.summary: Halogenated NBOMes (25I, 25B) and to a lesser extent 25H-NBOMe, 2C-H/I/B, and LSD increased reaction time dose-dependently. Increase strongly correlated with sensory inhibition.
outcomes.evidence: halogenated but not hydrogenated compounds significantly increased the reaction time of mice

D4_baseline.evidence: data expressed as percentage of baseline; baseline measured before injection

assays.assay_description: Forelimb grip strength on wire grid connected to force transducer; measured at 45, 70, 105, 160, 220, 280, 340 min post-injection.

setup_restrain.evidence: mice were held by their tails and allowed to grasp the grid

outcomes.summary: No effect of any compound on grip/muscle strength across the 5-h observation period.
outcomes.evidence: The muscle strength test response did not change in both the vehicle and treatment substance administration in mice over the 5-h observation period

D4_baseline.evidence: data expressed as percentage of baseline

assays.assay_description: Time on a cylinder accelerating 0–60 rpm, 300 s cutoff; measured at 15, 40, 70, 130, 190, 250, 310 min post-injection.

setup_restrain.evidence: placed on rotating cylinder, freely moving

outcomes.summary: No effect of any compound on accelerod performance.
outcomes.evidence: The accelerod test response did not change in both the vehicle and treatment substance administration in mice over the 5-h observation period

D4_baseline.evidence: data expressed as percentage of baseline

assays.assay_description: Mouse dragged backward by tail across 100 cm at constant speed; number of forelimb steps counted at 45, 70, 105, 160, 220, 280, 340 min post-injection.

setup_restrain.evidence: mouse was lifted by the tail ... dragged backward

outcomes.summary: No effect of any compound on drag step count across the 5-h observation period.
outcomes.evidence: The drag test response did not change in both the vehicle and treatment substance administration in mice over the 5-h observation period

assays.assay_description: Spontaneous locomotion (total distance traveled and time in central C1 zone) measured with ANY-maze video tracking over ~4 h after i.p. injection.

application_type.evidence: administered intraperitoneally (i.p.) in mice and each animal was singly placed in the open field box

time_to_assay.evidence: each animal was singly placed in the open field box (recording started immediately after i.p. injection)

sample_size.evidence: eight mice (total mice used: 336) were used for each treatment (vehicle or 5 doses)

outcomes.summary: 25I-NBOMe and LSD increased distance at low/intermediate doses and inhibited it at 10 mg/kg; 25H/25B-NBOMe and 2C compounds largely unchanged except at 10 mg/kg. Time in center C1 zone was decreased by NBOMes and LSD at 0.01–10 mg/kg, and by 2C compounds at higher doses.
outcomes.evidence: inhibitory effect only at the highest dose tested for all substances (10 mg/kg). In addition, low doses of LSD present stimulating effects

B1_num_measures.evidence: total distance traveled (m) and the time spent in the central C1 zone (seconds)

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: effect of time F(15,672)=105.1, p<0.0001 — binned across session

B4_ethological.evidence: locomotion and zone time, not natural behaviour acts

E7_social_context.evidence: each animal was singly placed in the open field box

D1_continuity.evidence: one continuous OFT recording per mouse, ~4 h

D2_session_duration.evidence: 4-h observation period referenced for C-zone analysis

D4_baseline.evidence: no pre-drug baseline recorded for OFT

assays.assay_description: Startle reactivity and PPI in startle chambers (Ugo Basile) with 68, 75, 85 dB prepulses; tested at 15 min and 120 min post-injection.

setup_restrain.evidence: transparent non-restrictive Perspex cage (90x45x50 mm) — small holder restricts movement during startle recording

sample_size.evidence: eight mice (total mice used: 272) were used for each treatment

outcomes.summary: NBOMe series (especially 25I, 25B) and LSD reduced acoustic startle amplitude at high doses and disrupted PPI; 2C compounds had little/no effect on startle amplitude but 2C-B/2C-I disrupted PPI at high doses.
outcomes.evidence: Administration of -NBOMe series (0.001-10 mg/kg, i.p.) and LSD (0.1-10 mg/kg, i.p.) caused an impairment of acoustic startle reflex

B1_num_measures.evidence: startle amplitude and %PPI at three prepulse intensities

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: two post-injection time points compared as separate sessions, not within-session dynamics

D1_continuity.evidence: tested at 15 min and 120 min after injection

D2_session_duration.evidence: standard startle session approximate; 300-ms readings × multiple trials, typically 15–60 min

D4_baseline.evidence: no pre-drug baseline within same assay reported

judge_notes: Treated visual object and visual placing as two separate assays (different paradigms within the sensorimotor battery) consistent with how the paper analyzes them.
Treated tactile (vibrissae+corneal+pinnae reflex sum) as one assay; B1 scored 2-3 measures because the sum derives from three distinct reflex components.
Acoustic reflex (sensorimotor battery) and PPI/startle (Ugo Basile chambers) treated as separate assays — different apparatus and behavioural construct.
Open field (locomotion + center time) collapsed into one assay; ANY-maze does centroid tracking only, so B7=0.
PPI temporal_dynamics scored 0 because 15-min and 120-min tests are between-session comparisons, not within-session time bins.
All assays single-day acute; D3=0. Reaction time/drag/accelerod/grip strength data are expressed as percent of baseline, supporting D4=Yes for those assays.
Sex: only male subjects; n_female set to 0 to reflect explicit absence.
